definitions.explanation: The final stage or ultimate end of something, especially of the world, of life, or of a long process. Carries a weightier, often apocalyptic or terminal nuance than a simple ending.

examples.japanese: ⟦{世界|せかい}→世界：01447_sekai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{終末|しゅうまつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{描|えが}く→描く：02013_egaku⟧。
examples.english: It depicts the end of the world.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{映画|えいが}→映画：02273_eiga⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{文明|ぶんめい}→文明：03611_bunmei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{終末|しゅうまつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦テーマ→テーマ：17684_teema⟧にして⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: This film takes the demise of civilization as its theme.

examples.japanese: {終末|しゅうまつ}⟦{医療|いりょう}→医療：01836_iryou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{患者|かんじゃ}→患者：00170_kanja⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{苦痛|くつう}→苦痛：02652_kutsuu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{和|やわ}らげる→和らげる：07897_yawarageru⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{重視|じゅうし}される→重視する：26832_juushisuru⟧。
examples.english: In end-of-life care, easing the patient's suffering is given priority.

notes:
Refers to a grave or ultimate ending — of the world, of life, or of an era — not an everyday conclusion. A homophone of ⟦{週末|しゅうまつ}→週末：03030_shuumatsu⟧ (weekend), distinguished only by context and kanji.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {終末|しゅうまつ}{期|き}: terminal stage (e.g. of an illness)
- {終末|しゅうまつ}⟦{医療|いりょう}→医療：01836_iryou⟧: end-of-life (terminal) care
- {終末|しゅうまつ}⟦{思想|しそう}→思想：03173_shisou⟧: eschatology; apocalyptic thought
- ⟦{世界|せかい}→世界：01447_sekai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{終末|しゅうまつ}: the end of the world

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{最後|さいご}→最後：01413_saigo⟧: the last; the end — ordinary, neutral word for the final point.
- ⟦{終|お}わり→終わり：01361_owari⟧: end; ending — the everyday word, without the grave nuance.
- ⟦{末期|まっき}→末期：13032_makki⟧: final period; terminal stage — the closing phase of an era or illness.
